rows.representation: closed metric tubes / closed leather shell
rows.layerMechanics: one native needle surface with metric thickness; no duplicated fabric
rows.outerSideConvention: outward oriented original panels, right-side knit throughout exterior
rows.shadowGeometry: identical displaced solid yarn / leather depth pass
rows.seamForceModel: shared cloth seam constraints; prescribed native stitch routes, not per-thread friction simulation
rows.primitiveBatching: same templates, intervals, material and LOD; no strand removal
rows.lod: closed cross-sections with subpixel crimp average; native crossings restored in macro
rows.twistConvention: R11 twist pitch in mm with helix-normal ply frames
rows.subpixelColour: analytic 3:1 twill colour average, closed geometry retained
